quests.instruction: STRIKE THE DRUM PAD CONTAINING THE STRESSED SYLLABLE
quests.hint: Say 'basket' out loud. One syllable will sound louder, longer, and clearer than the others - that is the stressed syllable.
quests.explanation: 'basket' is stressed on the first syllable: BAS-ket. Practising simple words like this trains your ear to hear the stressed beat in any word.
quests.stressRule: Noun Stress Rule: Most 2-syllable nouns and adjectives are stressed on the FIRST syllable.
